underlay_note: Non-paint regions (pilot, mechanical, interior) keep the per-texel median of these shipped liveries: the stock cockpit panels, gear and pilot wherever most of them agree.
source: GeoFS F-16 model models/aircraft/premium/f16/f16.gltf, material '_1_-_Default' (texture.jpg = LiverySelector F-16 slot, texture index 3)
method: Every textured triangle of the model rasterized into UV space and labelled from its part name, 3D position and facing (tools/uv_regions.py). UV v runs down the image (row = v * height), verified against the helmet/pilot island.

geom_axes.G: height: 0 = lowest point .. 255 = top of the fin

in_sim: UNVERIFIED IN-SIM: derived from the model files, not yet checked with the region-ID sheet in GeoFS.

regions.name: fuselage_top
regions.where: upper fuselage and strakes, nose to tail, seen from above

regions.name: fuselage_bottom
regions.where: belly aft of the intake, seen from below

regions.name: fuselage_side_l
regions.where: left fuselage side, texels used by the left side only
regions.notes: Side vs top/bottom is a facing cut (|normal.y| < 0.45); most of the F-16's sides unwrap into fuselage_top / fuselage_bottom. Use the geom map's height for side stripes.

regions.name: fuselage_side_r
regions.where: right fuselage side, texels used by the right side only

regions.name: fuselage_side_both
regions.where: fuselage side texels shared by BOTH sides (mirrored)
regions.notes: Anything painted here shows on both sides; text reads backwards on one of them. Same facing cut as fuselage_side_l.

regions.name: radome
regions.where: nose cone forward of the cockpit
regions.notes: Aft edge is a geometric cut 1.9 m from the tip, not a panel line.

regions.name: canopy_frame
regions.where: canopy frame and sill (the glass is a separate untextured material)

regions.name: intake
regions.where: chin intake: lip, sides and underside back to the main gear
regions.notes: Geometric cut: under the fuselage between 0.8 m and 4.4 m ahead of the wing box. The intake/belly boundary is approximate.

regions.name: nozzle
regions.where: engine nozzle petals and the aft tail pipe

regions.name: ventral_fins
regions.where: the two small ventral fins under the tail
regions.notes: Geometric cut; both fins share texels.

regions.name: fin
regions.where: vertical fin, BOTH sides share one island
regions.notes: Mirrored: text painted here reads correctly on one side and backwards on the other. This is why the stock tail code reads backwards in the texture.

regions.name: rudder
regions.where: rudder, both sides share

regions.name: wing_top_l
regions.where: left wing upper surface

regions.name: wing_top_r
regions.where: right wing upper surface

regions.name: wing_bottom
regions.where: wing lower surfaces, left AND right share one island
regions.notes: Mirrored: left and right undersides are the same texels.

regions.name: wing_leading_edges
regions.where: leading-edge flaps and fixed leading edge, both wings share

regions.name: flaperons
regions.where: flaperons (trailing-edge control surfaces)
regions.notes: Partly shared between left and right.

regions.name: hstab_top_r
regions.where: right horizontal stabilizer, upper surface

regions.name: hstab_shared
regions.where: left h-stab upper surface and both h-stab undersides share one island

regions.name: speedbrakes
regions.where: speed brakes either side of the nozzle

regions.name: gear_doors
regions.where: landing gear doors (visible when the gear is down)

regions.name: wingtip_rails
regions.where: wingtip missile rails

regions.name: pilot
regions.where: pilot figure and helmet (don't paint)

regions.name: mechanical
regions.where: gear legs, wheels, bays, hook, actuators (don't paint)

regions.name: interior
regions.where: cockpit tub and panels, intake duct, bays: body faces not visible from outside (don't paint)
regions.notes: From a 26-direction z-buffer visibility pass with the canopy glass treated as opaque.
